title: Microscope
prompt: a school light microscope: turn on the light, place a slide on the stage, turn the focus knob until the cells sharpen, rotate the nosepiece to change lenses, and explode it into parts; see-through shows the lamp, condenser, objective lenses, eyepiece and focus rack
blurb: A school light microscope: switch on the LED, lay an onion-skin slide on the stage, rack the stage up until the cells snap into focus, and click the nosepiece between 4×, 10× and 40× to watch the field of view shrink.
